descriptionChirho: To make ceremonially or morally clean; used transitively of purifying hearts, souls, or persons through active effort (1 John 3:3; 1 Pet 1:22; John 11:55).
To undergo ceremonial or moral purification; reflexive or passive — purifying oneself or being purified, especially in the context of Jewish ritual purification (Acts 21:24, 21:26, 24:18; Jas 4:8).
